additional_changes.change: Require exactly one text/base64 bytes representation; decode base64 and validate UTF8 byte range associations; reject invalid base64 and overlapping submatch ranges.
Keep begin/end as required units when the file has no match/context event, so its only path occurrence is retained; omitted boundaries are repaired.
additional_changes.evidence: Regression tested; original loss was identified in code review rather than separately executed against the pre-edit build.

additional_changes.change: Duplicate keys in the raw JSON request, including escaped aliases and nested metadata keys, return invalid_json_request before selecting raw/process.
Count logical lines before splitting raw and candidate strings; candidate over 50,000 lines falls back with candidate_line_budget_exceeded. Existing 50,000 source-line budget unchanged.
No candidate matching implementation change was justified. Tests show repeated same-text units need distinct occurrences and partial similar failure blocks are repaired.

limitations: The guarded source profiles remain flat Node TAP and single-line ripgrep JSON. Multiline or NUL-delimited ripgrep records conservatively return the original.
Known optional ancillary ripgrep statistics may be omitted in minimal fixtures; supplied values must be known and well typed. This is not a complete versioned ripgrep schema validator.

Input metadata and source facts are not authenticated. Byte-range and count consistency do not prove filesystem truth, search completeness, test correctness, or resistance to malicious original instructions.
Counters and positions use the existing int32 numeric profile; larger values fall back.
Line preflight avoids allocating an oversized line array, but character/line budgets are not a strict RSS memory quota.
The parent agent owns final dist rebuild, integrated checks and packaging; this report does not claim publication, CI or submission.
